title: Performance Setup
subtitle: Personalize your performance tab
welcome:
Let's set up your **performance tab** for what you actually do.

I'll ask a few quick questions so Seldom OS and your coach know what you're working on. Everything stays editable.
completeMessage: Your performance tab is ready. Log sessions, metrics, or notes as you go — the dashboard stays blank until you add data here.

steps.question: What's your main focus in this area right now?
steps.placeholder: e.g. Consistency, Grade 8 piano piece, 5K under 25 min

steps.question: How do you usually track progress?
What's one goal you're chasing in this area?
steps.placeholder: e.g. Perform at spring recital, Climb V5 consistently

steps.question: Name one strength you want to lean on. Optional — type **skip** to leave blank.
Name one area you're actively improving. Optional — type **skip**.
steps.placeholder: e.g. Speed under fatigue, Stage nerves
